summary: Iteration 9 (news agent + shadow trades + 3→2 migration). Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (tests/test_iter9_news_shadow.py): unit tests for NewsAgent.gate (ALTO event in 30 min blocks, 120 min doesn't, MEDIO event doesn't, CRITICA alert on XRPUSDT blocks only XRP, pair risk ALTO gives factor 0.5, news disabled gives (None,1.0), block_critical/reduce off gives no block or factor), parse_feed RSS+Atom, relevant() returns {BTCUSDT,SOLUSDT}; GET /api/news, POST /api/news/refresh (<60s, newer updated_at, 40 headlines with all fields, valid enums), dashboard.news enabled/ready; config news_* fields, telegram_alerts.news PUT, PUT 30/0.7 → 200, 2 → 422, 1.5 → 422, restored 20/0.5; shadow lifecycle: a synthetic BTCUSDT shadow with SL above price closed in under 15s as SL with negative pnl, and performance.shadow showed BLOQUEADA, filter_value == -total.pnl and 4 confidence buckets. inject_signal.py SOLUSDT long → Claude RECHAZADA (80%) → shadow_position created with kind RECHAZADA and ai_confidence 80. POST /api/account/reset cleared positions/trades/signals/shadow_positions/shadow_trades. Profile set back to 0. Migration 2026-10-20-activo is recorded in db.migrations. Frontend: all checks passed. News tab shows market risk/sentiment/summary, pairs, events and 40 headline links. The refresh button disables and shows a spinner, then the toast 'Noticias actualizadas' appears. Performance tab shows shadow-empty with the open count ('4 en seguimiento'); with seeded closed shadows it shows shadow-total/avoided/missed/filter-value/ai-value plus the by-kind, by-confidence, by-strategy and by-symbol tables, and the values are correct. Ajustes: all news-section controls are present; interval 25 → toast 'Agente de noticias guardado' and /api/config returns 25, then restored to 20. The Telegram toggle 'Alertas de noticias graves y eventos macro' is present. NOTICIAS fuchsia badge is defined in AiSignals; no NOTICIAS signals existed, so it was not rendered.
action_items: Optional: size RECHAZADA/BAJA_CONFIANZA shadows with the same news risk_factor that the real trade would have used (open_shadow ignores risk_factor). Today, shadow PnL is overstated when news risk is ALTO.

Optional: alerts get at=now_iso() on every refresh, so the 24h window in gate() for CRITICA alerts never really expires while Claude keeps reporting the alert, and it disappears as soon as Claude omits it. Consider keeping the first-seen time per alert key. summary.critical also skips the 24h age filter that gate() applies.
Optional: validate pairs[*].risk against BAJO|MEDIO|ALTO (only market.risk is validated) and add a TTL/cap to db.news_history (it grows without limit).
